csv_project_name: A/E Service for Turnagain Street Upgrade Project
csv_scope_of_work: PM&E is soliciting proposals from qualified consultants to provide architectural/engineering services for the Turnagain Street Upgrade project. The project will upgrade Turnagain Street from West Northern Lights Boulevard to West 35th Avenue as a Neighborhood Collector shown in Attachment B. The road is a north-south roadway with two 11-foot wide, strip-paved lanes and a 2-foot wide gravel shoulder on both sides. The public right-of-way (ROW) is approximately 40 feet. The posted speed limit is 25 MPH and there are no existing pedestrian facilities. The scope includes evaluating the need for improvements to the roadway and pedestrian facilities, surface and subsurface drainage, pedestrian and vehicular connectivity, landscaping, traffic calming, and street lighting
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Traffic Design Engineering
